notes.title: Confirmed Release Date
notes.notes:
VEDETTE will release 24:00 June 22/ 0:00 June 23 to start off the Steam Summer Sale! Add the game to your wishlist to be notified on release! There will be a huge discount upon release, don't miss out!

There is also a giveaway being hosted on the discord, invite your friends for a chance to win one of five keys the day after launch!
